messages:
morgan-cs: Helix Diagnostics onboarding: need EU egress allowlist + short QPS lift for their patient-triage pilot. They're privacy-sensitive; prefer private peering to reduce exposure.

raj-netops: Please share CIDRs and pilot window. We'll need to validate against our EU firewall policy. Private peering note: for Private customers we typically require an MSA. Is Helix on Private?

morgan-cs: They're on Hosted but requested private peering for the pilot. Contact is ops@helixdiag.example (PII-lite). CIDRs: 203.0.113.64/26. Pilot window: 2026-07-02 07:00-14:00 UTC. Requested temp QPS 200 -> 300. Auto-revoke 48h.

tess-ops: Opening INF-4901. Provisional QPS=300. Private peering requires legal sign-off; I'll spin up NAT fallback immediately and add allowlist.

sysbot: INF-4901 created and assigned to raj-netops, tess-ops. Expected allowlist update propagation: ~1 hour. Private peering escalated to legal.

raj-netops: Allowlist entry added to EU region. NAT fallback enabled. We'll perform kvcache warmup 1h prior to window. If legal approves, we'll convert to dedicated private peering after pilot.

morgan-cs: Thanks. I'll prepare the CSAT + feedback form for the pilot and note renewal touchpoint depending on pilot success. We'll capture latency baseline before and after peering change.

tess-ops: Runbook attached in ticket (INF-4901). Quick tests included. Will monitor during pilot.
